episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the current mortgage market, highlighting the drop in interest rates and its implications for buyers. He explains the importance of pricing strategies around FHA loan limits and introduces non-QM loans as a solution for self-employed buyers. Austin also emphasizes the potential of 'ghost buyers' and how agents can tap into this overlooked market segment.
